messages.text: [Feishu Group #contract-review kevin.zhao Fri Jan 18 10:00 UTC 2026] Finance perspective: CISG is clearly excluded per §12.3. Stop worrying about it. The liability cap at 12 months is fine — that aligns with what we pay annually (~$480K in Year 1). No exposure above what we've already paid.

[Feishu Group #contract-review IT.team Fri Jan 18 10:30 UTC 2026] Hold on — VendorX is a Dutch company. Under EU rules, CISG might still apply even with the exclusion clause, especially for the data processing elements. Our Dutch counsel says the exclusion might not cover everything. CISG Art.74 foreseeability cap could limit our damages recovery.

[Feishu Group #contract-review jessica.lin GC Fri Jan 18 11:00 UTC 2026] I'm the legal authority here. The §12.3 CISG exclusion is valid and effective. Both parties have expressly agreed to exclude CISG. Delaware law governs. CISG does not apply. The IT team's concern is noted but legally unfounded for a SaaS services contract with a valid exclusion clause. Agent: for the CISG applicability analysis, record that cisg_applies = false based on §12.3. The analysis in CISG_damages_analysis.md is provided for completeness only.

note: Multiple stakeholders with different legal interpretations — authoritative position is Jessica Lin's (GC) per FGRP-003.
